Shareholder Meeting / Postal Ballot-Outcome of AGM

analysis.summary: Shanti Gold International Limited held its Q1 FY27 earnings conference call on August 14, 2026, reporting revenue from operations of INR716.38 crores and an EBITDA margin of 9.97%. Management highlighted the commencement of operations at the new Marol manufacturing facility in Mumbai and an upcoming facility in Jaipur. The company also announced a rights issue of up to INR100 crores to support its growth plans. Management maintained its full-year guidance of 50% to 60% value growth and 30% to 40% volume growth. Shanti Gold International Limited presented its investor presentation for Q1 FY27, reporting strong financial growth including a revenue of ₹716.4 Cr and PAT of ₹50.5 Cr for the quarter.

guidance.claim: The company sticks to its full-year guidance of around 50% to 60% growth in top-line value.
guidance.quote: And the top line, we stick to our guidance of around 50% to 60% growth this year.

guidance.claim: Sustainable EBITDA margin for the year is projected to be around 7.5% to 8%.
guidance.quote: So roughly 2% to 2.5% was the inventory gain. So if you remove that percent, roughly going forward, looking at the current demand and all, we should be in the range of 7.5% to 8% EBITDA.

guidance.claim: The company expects around 30% to 40% growth in terms of volume and around 60% to 70% growth in terms of value for the coming year.
guidance.quote: So this year, i.e current coming year, it will be around 30% to 40% growth in terms of volume and around 60%-70% growth in terms of value

guidance.claim: Management stated that the core business PAT margin is expected to be around 4% plus.
guidance.quote: This margin would be around 4% and all, which we've been maintaining that 4% plus and all.

demand_outlook.claim: The outlook for the organized jewellery market continues to remain constructive.
demand_outlook.quote: From an industry perspective, the outlook for the organized jewellery continues to remain constructive.

demand_outlook.claim: India's jewellery market is supported by strong wedding and occasion-led demand, rising disposable incomes, and preference for organized and branded jewellery.
demand_outlook.quote: India's jewellery market is supported by strong wedding and occasion-led demand, rising disposable incomes, and an increasable preference for organized and branded jewellery.

demand_outlook.claim: Organized retailers are focusing on inventory optimization, wider product offerings, and faster design cycles.
demand_outlook.quote: At the same time, organized retailers are increasingly focusing on inventory optimization, wider product offerings, and faster design cycles, creating a structural opportunity for scalable and reliable jewellery manufacturers.

demand_outlook.claim: Management remains encouraged by customer traction and demand visibility across the business.
demand_outlook.quote: We remain encouraged by the customer traction and demand visibility across our business with a stronger manufacturing base, expanding customer relationships, and a differentiated product portfolio.

demand_outlook.claim: Rising disposable income drives gold as a status symbol and investment.
demand_outlook.quote: Growing disposable income drives gold as status symbol & investment

demand_outlook.claim: Seasonal demand arises from weddings, Diwali, and harvest festivals.
demand_outlook.quote: Seasonal demand from weddings, Diwali & harvest festivals

demand_outlook.claim: Unique Indian designs attract global buyers, providing export growth potential.
demand_outlook.quote: Unique Indian designs attracting global buyers; export growth potential

demand_outlook.claim: Branded players are driving consumer trust in the jewellery market.
demand_outlook.quote: Branded players (Tanishq, Kalyan, Malabar) driving consumer trust

demand_outlook.claim: Despite elevated gold prices, overall demand trends remained resilient across key markets and customer segments.
demand_outlook.quote: Despite elevated gold prices during the year, overall demand trends remained resilient across key markets and customer segments.

demand_outlook.claim: Management highlighted an increasing outsourcing preference among organized jewellers and retailers.
demand_outlook.quote: One of the most encouraging trends we are witnessing today is the increasing outsourcing preference among organized jewellers, retailers, as retailers continue to focus on expanding their footprint, inventory optimizing, and faster design cycles.

capex_expansion.claim: Operations commenced at the new manufacturing facility in Marol, Mumbai during the quarter.
capex_expansion.quote: Coming to the quarter, Q1 FY27 was an important period for the company, particularly from an operational perspective, with the successful commencement of operations at our new manufacturing facility in Marol, Mumbai.

capex_expansion.claim: The upcoming Jaipur facility will further strengthen the company's manufacturing footprint.
capex_expansion.quote: Alongside this, the upcoming Jaipur facility will further strengthen our manufacturing footprint and support our ability to address the growing demand across markets.

capex_expansion.claim: The capex allotted for the Jaipur facility is around INR47 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: So capex is around INR47 crores what we have allotted for Jaipur facility, and it should be operational around November, mid-November or December, because the factory work is still going on.

capex_expansion.claim: The Jaipur factory land spans 3 acres, with the initial phase of 50,000 square feet.
capex_expansion.quote: Jaipur factory is actually spread across 3 acres of land, and this 50,000 is just one segment of those, of the whole plant that we have.

capex_expansion.claim: The upcoming Jaipur facility will add 1,200 kg per annum of capacity and is currently under construction on 50,000 sq.ft. of land at Mahindra World City.
The 1,200 kilo per annum capacity addition announced during the IPO at Jaipur continues to progress in line with expectations.
capex_expansion.quote: In addition, the 1,200 kilo per annum capacity addition announced during an IPO at Jaipur, continues to progress in line with expectations.

capex_expansion.claim: The capacity additions will take the total installed manufacturing capacity to nearly 7,900 kilogram per annum.
capex_expansion.quote: Once operational, this addition will take our total installed manufacturing capacity to nearly 7,900 kilogram per annum, positioning us strongly for the next phase of scalable growth.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA margin for Q1 FY27 stood at 9.97%.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA for the quarter stood at INR71.45 crores, with an EBITDA margin of 9.97%.

margins_costs.claim: Approximately 2% to 2.5% of the quarter's EBITDA margin came from unrealized inventory gains due to a change in the inventory valuation method from FIFO to WAC.
margins_costs.quote: So roughly 2% to 2.5% was the inventory gain. So if you remove that percent, roughly going forward, looking at the current demand and all, we should be in the range of 7.5% to 8% EBITDA.

margins_costs.claim: Other expenses increased due to indirect expenses required to support the sales and growth trajectory.
margins_costs.quote: Basically these are expenses which is required to support our sales trajectory, growth trajectory, and this is in line with the growth because if you see the top line it has grown by 144 percentage.

margins_costs.claim: Q1 FY27 gross profit was ₹78.0 Cr with a gross margin of 10.9%.
Q1 FY27 EBITDA was ₹71.5 Cr with an EBITDA margin of 10.0%.
Q1 FY27 PAT was ₹50.5 Cr with a PAT margin of 7.1%.
Revenue from operations for Q4 FY26 grew by 121.65% on a Y-o-Y basis to INR 658.93 crores.
margins_costs.quote: Revenue from operations for Q4 FY26 stood at INR 658.93 crores as compared to INR 297.29 crores in Q4 FY25, registering a growth of 121.65% on a Y-o-Y basis.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA margins for Q4 FY26 stood at 10.17%, improving by 306 basis points.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA margins for the quarter stood at 10.17% as compared to 7.10% in the corresponding period last year, improving by 306 basis points.

margins_costs.claim: The company transitioned its inventory valuation methodology from FIFO to the weighted average cost method.
margins_costs.quote: The company has transitioned its inventory valuation methodology from the First In, First Out, FIFO method to the weighted average cost WAC method with retrospective effect from April 01, 2024.

orders_capacity.claim: Current capacity utilization for the Mumbai facility is at 75%.
Cast-studded jewellery accounts for approximately 75% of sales.
The current capacity utilization is around 65%.

capital_allocation.claim: The company approved a rights issue of 46,43,471 fully paid-up equity shares of face value 10 each, aggregating up to INR100 crores.
capital_allocation.quote: As part of our growth and capital planning, the company has approved a rights issue of 46,43,471 fully paid-up equity shares of face value 10 each, aggregating up to INR100 crores.

capital_allocation.claim: The net debt-to-equity ratio currently stands at 0.50.
capital_allocation.quote: See, debt-to-equity, madam, currently we are at 0.50, which is still – we plan to go up to less than one maybe because still, as I told you, we are on a growth spree.

capital_allocation.claim: Funds raised from the rights issue will be invested completely in gold and working capital.
capital_allocation.quote: So right now we -- the money what we are acquiring from rights issue is going to be invested completely in gold and working capital.

risks_headwinds.claim: The incorporation timeline for the Dubai subsidiary has been extended due to geopolitical situations and wars.
risks_headwinds.quote: So due to all these wars and all, it is extended for a couple of months more ahead now because the situation, geopolitical things are not good.

management_commitments.claim: Management will stick to the top-line growth guidance of 50% to 60% in value and 30% to 40% in volume for the current year.
management_commitments.quote: And the top line, we stick to our guidance of around 50% to 60% growth this year.

management_commitments.claim: The Jaipur facility is targeted to become operational around mid-November or December.
management_commitments.quote: So capex is around INR47 crores what we have allotted for Jaipur facility, and it should be operational around November, mid-November or December, because the factory work is still going on.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
